violations.text: The door to the outside, located in the receiving area, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 08/06/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the produce walk-in cooler fans have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2026

The following areas have an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. -Along the floors in bakery area -Wall behind prep sink in meat cutting room -Drain by prep sink in meat cutting room The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2026

The pipe covering by the meat room prep sink is constructed of a foamy material. This material is not durable. Materials for the pipe covering shall be smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, ware-washing areas, and toilet rooms. This area was observed to be not easily cleanable. Per PIC, a work order will be placed. New Violation. Correct By: 08/06/2026
No person certified in food safety was present as needed at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 09/12/2024
Several air curtains throughout walk-in cooler entrances were osberved in poor repair. New Violation. Correct By: 09/26/2024
The non-food contact surfaces of the fan covers in a walk-in have an accumulation of dust. New Violation. Correct By: 09/13/2024
The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was blocked by baking racks. A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/10/2023

Single service items are not being stored properly in their original protective package and/or are stored on a surface that is not clean in the bakery and dry storage area. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/10/2023
The non-food contact surfaces of the vent covers in meat walk in have an accumulation of dust. New Violation. Correct By: 08/10/2023
